posts.hook: A lot of brand owners and even some formulators think the halal assurance obligation stops at their own name on the label. If you use a maklon (contract manufacturer) or a shared production kitchen, you assume that's their problem, not yours, or that nobody's problem until the finished good is packe

bm.linkedin:
Ramai brand owner dan formulator anggap kewajipan halal assurance berhenti pada nama mereka atas label sahaja. Kalau guna maklon atau dapur kongsi, ramai anggap itu masalah maklon tu, bukan masalah brand owner, sampailah produk siap dibungkus.

Draft Keputusan Ketua BPJPH tentang panduan SJPH ubah keadaan ni. Ia letak keperluan Sistem Jaminan Produk Halal terus atas processing service itu sendiri: maklon, dapur kongsi, dan perkhidmatan pemprosesan outsource lain, sama ada buat cosmetics, food, beverage atau medicine.

Secara praktikal, maklon kena ada halal assurance system dokumentasi sendiri, bukan pinjam sijil daripada brand yang dia proses untuk. Segregation, cleaning validation antara batch, raw material traceability, semua ni sekarang tanggungjawab siapa yang jalankan mesin atau filling line, bukan sekadar siapa punya SKU.

Public feedback untuk draft ni tutup 23 Nov 2026. Kalau anda run atau guna contract manufacturing untuk cosmetics ke Indonesia, ini dokumen yang perlu dibaca sebelum tarikh tu, bukan lepas tu.

Sources: BPJPH, Draft Keputusan Ketua BPJPH tentang Pedoman SJPH bagi Jasa Maklon dan sejenisnya (public consultation) [SAHKAN: nombor rujukan draft decision sebenar belum diterbitkan di halal.gov.my]

#HalalCompliance #BPJPH #Cosmetics #RegulatoryAffairs #ASEAN

en.linkedin:
A lot of brand owners and even some formulators think the halal assurance obligation stops at their own name on the label. If you use a maklon (contract manufacturer) or a shared production kitchen, you assume that's their problem, not yours, or that nobody's problem until the finished good is packed.

BPJPH's draft Keputusan Ketua BPJPH on SJPH guidelines changes that. It puts the Sistem Jaminan Produk Halal requirement directly on the processing service itself: maklon, dapur kongsi, and other outsourced processing operations, whether they're making cosmetics, food, beverages or medicine.

Practically, that means the toll manufacturer needs its own documented halal assurance system, not a borrowed certificate from the brand it's packing for. Segregation, cleaning validation between batches, raw material traceability, all of it now sits with whoever is running the vat or the filling line, not just whoever owns the SKU.

Public feedback on the draft closes 23 Nov 2026. If you run or use contract manufacturing for cosmetics into Indonesia, this is the document to read before then, not after.

Sources: BPJPH, Draft Keputusan Ketua BPJPH tentang Pedoman SJPH bagi Jasa Maklon dan sejenisnya (public consultation)

#HalalCompliance #BPJPH #Cosmetics #RegulatoryAffairs #ASEAN

posts.hook: Setiap kali artwork baharu siap, soalan sama muncul: logo halal kena hijau ke?

bm.instagram:
Setiap kali pereka pembungkusan hantar artwork baharu, soalan ini pasti timbul: logo halal wajib hijau ke supaya nampak 'betul'?

Bukan. Tak ada mana-mana peraturan yang kunci warna logo halal Malaysia kepada satu warna sahaja. Industri memang diberi ruang guna logo pelbagai warna, disesuaikan dengan warna latar pembungkusan produk, supaya logo tetap jelas dan tidak calar dengan reka bentuk keseluruhan.

Yang tak boleh berubah ialah spesifikasi logo itu sendiri: bentuk, nisbah saiz dan elemen di dalamnya. Ini yang ditetapkan oleh Pihak Berkuasa Berwibawa selari dengan Klausa 40(2), Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020. Warna fleksibel, tapi bentuk dan nisbah bukan tempat untuk kreativiti pereka grafik.

Sebab tu bila artwork masuk untuk kelulusan, rujuk klausa ni, bukan pendapat pembekal percetakan atau 'biasa client lain buat macam ni'. Ramai kena hantar semula artwork sebab logo diperkecilkan lebih daripada nisbah dibenarkan, bukan sebab warnanya salah.
bm.facebook:
Soalan yang sama datang setiap kali artwork pembungkusan baharu siap: logo halal mesti hijau ke?

Tak. Warna logo halal Malaysia boleh disesuaikan dengan pembungkusan produk. Yang tetap ialah bentuk, nisbah dan elemen logo, ikut Klausa 40(2), Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020.

Jadi bila pereka anda tanya pasal warna logo, rujuk klausa ni, bukan pendapat pembekal percetakan.
bm.threads: Logo halal mesti hijau? Tak. Warna boleh ikut pembungkusan anda, bentuk dan nisbah logo yang tetap, ikut Klausa 40(2) MPPHM 2020. Rujuk klausa tu, bukan pembekal percetakan.

en.instagram:
Every time a new packaging artwork gets finalised, the same question comes up: does the halal logo have to be green to be 'correct'?

No. There is no rule locking Malaysia's halal logo to one colour. Industry players are given room to use the logo in different colours matched to their packaging's background, so the logo stays visible and doesn't clash with the design.

What stays fixed is the logo's specification itself: its shape, size ratio and internal elements. This is set by the Competent Authority under Clause 40(2), Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020. Colour is flexible, shape and ratio are not up for creative interpretation.

So when artwork goes in for approval, cite this clause, not a printing vendor's opinion or 'that's what other clients did'. Most resubmissions happen because the logo was shrunk below the allowed ratio, not because the colour was wrong.
en.facebook:
The same question comes up with every new packaging artwork: does the halal logo have to be green?

No. Colour can match your packaging. What's fixed is the logo's shape, ratio and elements, under Clause 40(2), Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020.

So when your designer asks about logo colour, point them to this clause, not a printing vendor's opinion.
en.threads: Halal logo must be green? No. Colour can match your packaging, shape and ratio stay fixed under Clause 40(2) MPPHM 2020. Cite the clause, not your printer's opinion.

posts.hook: Fatwa kebangsaan kata suntikan Botox untuk kecantikan haram sejak 2006. Tapi 'haram' pada peringkat kebangsaan tak sama dengan 'kuat kuasa' di negeri anda.

bm.instagram:
Muzakarah Jawatankuasa Fatwa Majlis Kebangsaan Bagi Hal Ehwal Ugama Islam Malaysia Kali Ke-74, bersidang 25 hingga 27 Julai 2006, memutuskan bahawa suntikan Botulinum Toxin Type A (Botox) untuk tujuan kecantikan semata-mata adalah haram.

Ini keputusan di peringkat KEBANGSAAN, bukan pendapat seorang mufti dan bukan juga fatwa satu-satu negeri. Dari segi hierarki, ini lebih kukuh daripada kedua-dua itu.

Tapi ramai anggap sebaik sahaja Muzakarah MKI putuskan sesuatu, ia terus jadi undang-undang di seluruh Malaysia. Bukan begitu. Keputusan Muzakarah MKI bukan undang-undang secara automatik. Ia mengikat di sesebuah negeri hanya selepas diwartakan oleh Jawatankuasa Fatwa Negeri.

Jadi dua perkara yang perlu disemak berasingan: pertama, apa keputusan Muzakarah tu sebenarnya (dalam kes ni, Botox kosmetik haram); kedua, adakah negeri anda sendiri sudah mewartakannya secara rasmi.

Untuk pemilik klinik estetik, penjual produk berkaitan atau sesiapa yang menasihati pelanggan pasal isu ini, jangan berhenti pada 'fatwa kebangsaan dah kata haram'. Semak juga status warta di negeri tempat anda beroperasi.
bm.facebook:
Muzakarah Jawatankuasa Fatwa Majlis Kebangsaan Bagi Hal Ehwal Ugama Islam Malaysia Kali Ke-74 (25-27 Julai 2006) putuskan suntikan Botulinum Toxin Type A (Botox) untuk tujuan kecantikan adalah haram.

Tapi keputusan muzakarah kebangsaan ni tak terus jadi undang-undang serentak seluruh negara. Keputusan Muzakarah MKI bukan undang-undang secara automatik. Ia mengikat di sesebuah negeri hanya selepas diwartakan oleh Jawatankuasa Fatwa Negeri.

Kalau anda uruskan klinik estetik atau nasihatkan pelanggan pasal ini, semak dulu status warta di negeri anda sendiri, jangan anggap ia automatik berkuat kuasa serentak.
bm.threads: Muzakarah Kebangsaan Kali Ke-74 (2006) putuskan Botox untuk kecantikan haram. Tapi keputusan muzakarah bukan terus jadi undang-undang, ia kena diwartakan oleh Jawatankuasa Fatwa Negeri dulu baru mengikat negeri tu. Semak status warta negeri anda, jangan anggap automatik.

en.instagram:
Malaysia's National Fatwa Muzakarah Committee, sitting for its 74th session from 25 to 27 July 2006, ruled that using Botulinum Toxin Type A (Botox) injections purely for cosmetic purposes is haram.

This is a NATIONAL-level ruling, not a single mufti's personal opinion and not a single state's own fatwa. In the hierarchy of Islamic rulings in Malaysia, it sits above both of those.

But many assume that once the Muzakarah MKI decides something, it becomes law across the whole country immediately. That is not how it works. A Muzakarah MKI ruling is not automatically law. It only binds a specific state once gazetted by that state's own Fatwa Committee.

So there are two separate things to check: first, what the Muzakarah actually ruled (in this case, cosmetic Botox is haram); second, whether your own state has actually gazetted it.

For aesthetic clinic owners, sellers of related products, or anyone advising clients on this, don't stop at 'the national fatwa already said haram'. Check the gazette status in the state you actually operate in too.
en.facebook:
Malaysia's National Fatwa Muzakarah Committee (25-27 July 2006, 74th sitting) ruled that using Botulinum Toxin Type A (Botox) injections purely for cosmetic purposes is haram.

But a national muzakarah decision does not automatically become law everywhere at once. A Muzakarah MKI ruling is not automatically law -- it only binds a specific state once gazetted by that state's own Fatwa Committee.

If you run an aesthetic clinic or advise clients on this, check your own state's gazette status first, rather than assuming it applies uniformly the moment it was decided.

posts.hook: Many brand owners running through Indonesian contract manufacturers assume the maklon's halal certificate settles the halal question for their finished cosmetic. That assumption is about to get more expensive.

bm.linkedin:
Ramai brand owner yang guna kilang kontrak (maklon) di Indonesia anggap sijil halal maklon itu sudah cukup untuk produk kosmetik siap mereka. Andaian itu bakal jadi lebih mahal untuk disemak semula.

BPJPH Indonesia telah notify draf Keputusan Kepala BPJPH tentang garis panduan pelaksanaan SJPH (Sistem Jaminan Produk Halal) untuk perkhidmatan pemprosesan, dokumen WTO G/TBT/N/IDN/197, diedarkan 24 September 2026. Medan products covered menyenaraikan makanan, minuman, ubat dan kosmetik yang dihasilkan atau diproses melalui perkhidmatan pemprosesan, termasuk maklon, dapur kongsi, pemprosesan air dan pengisaran. Keperluan SJPH dikenakan ke atas pelaku perniagaan (business actor), bukan hanya kilang.

Ini satu pergeseran daripada mensijilkan produk siap kepada mensijilkan langkah pemprosesan itu sendiri. Satu sijil di maklon tidak automatik lepaskan kewajipan SJPH brand owner sendiri bila garis panduan ini kuat kuasa.

Tarikh penerimaan dan tarikh kuat kuasa masih to be determined. Tingkap maklum balas tutup 23 November 2026.

[SAHKAN: kewajipan SJPH tepat ke atas pelaku perniagaan yang guna perkhidmatan maklon di bawah draf ini -- draf 16 muka surat Bahasa Indonesia belum dibaca, hanya medan notifikasi WTO tersedia]

Sources: G/TBT/N/IDN/197 (WTO TBT notification, diedarkan 24/09/2026)

en.linkedin:
Many brand owners running through Indonesian contract manufacturers assume the maklon's halal certificate settles the halal question for their finished cosmetic. That assumption is about to get more expensive.

Indonesia's BPJPH has notified a draft Decision on SJPH implementation guidelines for processing services, WTO document G/TBT/N/IDN/197, distributed 24 September 2026. The products covered field lists food, beverages, drugs and cosmetics produced or processed through processing services, explicitly naming maklon, shared kitchens, water processing and milling. The SJPH obligation sits with the business actor, not just the facility.

That is a shift from certifying the finished product to certifying the processing step itself. One certificate at the maklon does not automatically discharge the brand owner's own SJPH obligation once this guideline lands.

Acceptance date and entry into force are still to be determined. The comment window closes 23 November 2026.

Sources: G/TBT/N/IDN/197 (WTO TBT notification, distributed 24/09/2026)

posts.hook: Tiada logo halal pada perniagaan tu bukan bermakna produk dia haram. Undang-undang jalan arah bertentangan.

bm.instagram:
Tiada Sijil Pengesahan Halal Malaysia (SPHM) bukan bermakna produk itu haram. Ini silap paling biasa yang saya nampak dalam perbualan pasal halal kebelakangan ini.

SPHM ialah pensijilan sukarela. Syarikat yang tak memohon tak melakukan sebarang kesalahan sebab tak ada sijil. Kesalahan sebenar berjalan arah bertentangan: mendakwa "halal", atau paparkan logo halal, tanpa sijil sah yang boleh kena tindakan di bawah Akta Perihal Dagangan 2011.

Untuk pengusaha: kalau anda belum ada SPHM, jangan tulis perkataan halal pada label atau signage, jangan letak logo, jangan guna ayat yang buat orang sangka anda bersijil. Anda masih boleh nyatakan bahan-bahan anda secara jujur, itu bukan kesalahan.

Untuk pengguna: takde sijil bermaksud takde maklumat yang disahkan pihak berkuasa, bukan bukti kandungan haram.

Di bawah Perintah Perihal Dagangan (Perakuan dan Penandaan Halal) 2011, hanya JAKIM dan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN) boleh perakukan status halal. Third party di media sosial, tak kira berapa ramai followers, bukan pihak berkuasa memperaku di bawah Perintah itu.
bm.facebook:
Tiada SPHM bukan bermakna haram. Ramai silap faham benda ni.

SPHM ialah pensijilan sukarela, jadi syarikat yang tak memohon tak buat salah. Kesalahan sebenar ialah mendakwa halal atau guna logo halal tanpa sijil sah, di bawah Akta Perihal Dagangan 2011.

Hanya JAKIM dan MAIN boleh perakukan status halal, bukan pihak ketiga di media sosial.
bm.threads: Tiada SPHM bukan bermakna haram. Ia pensijilan sukarela. Kesalahan sebenar ialah dakwa halal atau guna logo tanpa sijil sah, bukan sebaliknya. Hanya JAKIM & MAIN boleh perakukan halal.

en.instagram:
No Halal Certificate does not mean a product is haram. This is the most common mix-up I keep seeing in halal discussions lately.

Halal certification in Malaysia is voluntary. A business that never applied has not broken any law by not having one. The actual offence runs the other way: claiming "halal", or displaying a halal logo, without a valid certificate, which can attract action under the Trade Descriptions Act 2011.

For founders: if you don't have MYeHALAL certification, don't put the word halal on your label or signage, don't use the logo, and avoid phrasing that implies you're certified. You can still state your ingredients honestly, that's not an offence.

For consumers: no certificate means no verified information from the authority, not proof that something is haram.

Under the Trade Descriptions (Certification and Marking of Halal) Order 2011, only JAKIM and the State Islamic Religious Councils (MAIN) can certify halal status. Third parties on social media, no matter the following, are not a certifying authority under that Order.
en.facebook:
No halal certificate does not mean haram. This gets misunderstood constantly.

Certification is voluntary, so not applying is not an offence. Claiming halal or using the logo without a valid cert is the actual offence under the Trade Descriptions Act 2011.

Only JAKIM and MAIN can certify halal status, not anyone on social media.
en.threads: No halal cert doesn't mean haram. It's voluntary. The real offence is claiming halal or using the logo without a valid cert, not the absence of one. Only JAKIM and MAIN certify.

posts.hook: 27 September 2026 is not a date to note quietly. It's when EU member states must start applying the national measures transposing Directive (EU) 2024/825, and a lot of cosmetic marketing copy still uses exactly the kind of claim this Directive targets.

bm.linkedin:
27 September 2026 bukan tarikh untuk dilalui senyap. Itu tarikh negara anggota EU wajib mula guna pakai langkah kebangsaan yang mentransposisi Directive (EU) 2024/825, dan banyak salinan pemasaran kosmetik masih guna jenis dakwaan alam sekitar yang jadi sasaran arahan ini.

Directive (EU) 2024/825 meminda Unfair Commercial Practices Directive 2005/29/EC untuk melarang dakwaan alam sekitar yang generik dan tidak disokong bukti, contohnya perkataan 'eco-friendly', 'green', 'sustainable' atau 'natural' digunakan sebagai dakwaan umum tanpa pensijilan yang diiktiraf atau pengesahan bebas di belakangnya, serta dakwaan yang bersandar semata-mata pada skim offset pelepasan karbon.

Perkara 4(1) arahan ini, dibaca terus melalui EU cellar dalam beberapa larian sweep berasingan repositori ini (10 hingga 25 Sept 2026, bacaan yang sama setiap kali), menyatakan negara anggota wajib guna pakai langkah itu mulai 27 September 2026.

Untuk chemist atau RA peer yang uruskan SKU menghala ke EU: ini bukan deadline yang jauh, ia hujung minggu ini. Semak setiap perkataan 'eco', 'green', 'sustainable' atau 'natural' pada pembungkusan dan salinan pemasaran anda sekarang, sebelum ia disemak oleh orang lain.

[SAHKAN: senarai penuh jenis dakwaan yang dilarang dan mekanisme penguatkuasaan setiap negara anggota -- hanya Perkara 4(1) tentang tarikh guna pakai yang dibaca baris demi baris setakat ini]

Sources: Directive (EU) 2024/825, Article 4(1), EUR-Lex CELEX:32024L0825

#RegulatoryAffairs #GreenClaims #CosmeticRegulation #EUCompliance #Greenwashing

en.linkedin:
27 September 2026 is not a date to note quietly. It's when EU member states must start applying the national measures transposing Directive (EU) 2024/825, and a lot of cosmetic marketing copy still uses exactly the kind of claim this Directive targets.

Directive (EU) 2024/825 amends the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive 2005/29/EC to ban generic, unsubstantiated environmental claims, things like 'eco-friendly', 'green', 'sustainable' or 'natural' used as a blanket claim with no recognised certification or independent verification behind it, and claims that rest solely on emissions-offsetting schemes.

Article 4(1), read directly through the EU cellar endpoint across several separate sweep runs in this repository (10 through 25 Sept 2026, the same text every time), states member states shall apply those measures from 27 September 2026.

For a chemist or RA peer managing an EU-facing SKU: this is not a distant deadline, it is this weekend. Audit every 'eco', 'green', 'sustainable' or 'natural' word on your packaging and marketing copy now, before someone else does.

Sources: Directive (EU) 2024/825, Article 4(1), EUR-Lex CELEX:32024L0825

#RegulatoryAffairs #GreenClaims #CosmeticRegulation #EUCompliance #Greenwashing

posts.hook: Remy Laure Soothing Cream: notifikasi kena batal 24 Ogos 2026 sebab hydroquinone.

bm.instagram:
Notifikasi NPRA keluar, ramai ingat produk dah 'lulus'. Tak.

Remy Laure Soothing Cream kena batal notifikasi pada 24 Ogos 2026 sebab hydroquinone dikesan dalam formula. Hydroquinone bahan ubat, dilarang dalam kosmetik.

Nombor notifikasi keluar based on apa syarikat isytiharkan sendiri masa hantar permohonan. NPRA tak uji kandungan dulu.

Ujian sebenar jalan lepas produk di pasaran, melalui sampling dan aduan. Kalau kandungan tak match isytihar, atau ada bahan larangan, notifikasi boleh dibatalkan bila-bila, walau dah aktif bertahun.

Jadi bila produk ditarik, 'NPRA dah luluskan' tak boleh pakai. Notifikasi bukan pengesahan kandungan. Tanggungjawab formula 100% pada syarikat yang notify.
bm.facebook:
Remy Laure Soothing Cream kena batal notifikasi NPRA pada 24 Ogos 2026 sebab ada hydroquinone, bahan ubat yang dilarang dalam kosmetik.

Notifikasi bukan lulus. Nombor keluar based on isytihar syarikat sendiri, bukan ujian NPRA. Ujian sebenar jalan lepas produk di pasaran.

Bila kena batal, tak boleh cakap 'NPRA dah luluskan'. Kandungan tak pernah disahkan sejak awal.
bm.threads: Notifikasi NPRA bukan lulus. Remy Laure Soothing Cream kena batal 24 Ogos 2026 sebab hydroquinone. Nombor keluar based on isytihar syarikat sendiri, NPRA tak uji dulu. Bila kena tarik, jangan cakap 'dah lulus'.

en.instagram:
An NPRA notification number does not mean the product passed testing.

Remy Laure Soothing Cream had its notification cancelled 24 August 2026 after hydroquinone turned up in the formula. A drug ingredient, banned in cosmetics.

The number is issued on what the company declares at submission. NPRA does not test upfront.

Real testing happens post-market, through sampling and complaints. If content does not match the declaration, or a banned substance shows up, the notification can be cancelled anytime, even years later.

So when a product gets pulled, 'but NPRA approved it' does not hold. That responsibility sits with the company that notified it.
en.facebook:
Remy Laure Soothing Cream had its NPRA notification cancelled 24 August 2026 after hydroquinone, a drug ingredient banned in cosmetics, was found in the formula.

Notification is not approval. The number is issued on self-declaration, NPRA never tests it upfront. Real testing happens after the product is already on the market.

When it gets cancelled, 'NPRA approved it' does not hold. Nobody verified the content in the first place.
en.threads: NPRA notification is not approval. Remy Laure Soothing Cream was cancelled 24 Aug 2026 over hydroquinone. The number rests on self-declaration, testing happens post-market. When a product gets pulled, 'it was approved' does not hold.

posts.hook: Senarai pembatalan NPRA bukan berita. Ia dokumen kerja percuma yang kebanyakan peruncit tak pernah buka.

bm.instagram:
Ramai peruncit kosmetik anggap senarai pembatalan notifikasi NPRA sebagai sesuatu yang mereka baca bila ia jadi viral. Sebenarnya ia dokumen kerja, dikemas kini sepanjang tahun, terbuka kepada sesiapa sahaja, dan percuma untuk disemak.

Setakat semakan 19 Sept 2026, antara yang tersenarai: Saqa Glowing Turmeric Night Treatment Cream (merkuri), Glowing Night Treatment dan Glowing Herbal Treatment, Chomel Hand Sanitizer (methanol), Remy Laure Soothing Cream (hydroquinone).

Sebaik sahaja notifikasi dibatalkan, produk itu tak boleh diimport, dikilang, diedar atau dijual, tak kira berapa lama ia dah duduk atas rak anda. 'Saya tak tahu ia dah dibatalkan' bukan pembelaan bila rekod itu public dan anda memang tak semak.

Kalau anda peruncit, dropshipper atau pemilik kedai kosmetik, semak senarai ni sebelum anda letak deposit untuk stok baharu. Bukan selepas pelanggan hantar mesej tanya kenapa produk yang anda jual ada dalam senarai tu.

Due diligence bukan kerja NPRA sahaja. Bila produk itu atas rak anda, tanggungjawab semak jatuh pada anda juga.

Senarai pembatalan notifikasi kosmetik NPRA bukan berita, ia dokumen kerja yang dikemas kini sepanjang tahun dan percuma untuk sesiapa semak.

en.instagram:
Most cosmetics retailers treat NPRA's product notification cancellation list as something they only read about when it goes viral. It is actually a working document, updated all year, open to anyone, and free to check.

As of the 19 Sept 2026 review, listed products include Saqa Glowing Turmeric Night Treatment Cream (mercury), Glowing Night Treatment and Glowing Herbal Treatment, Chomel Hand Sanitizer (methanol), and Remy Laure Soothing Cream (hydroquinone).

Once a notification is cancelled, that product cannot be imported, manufactured, distributed or sold, no matter how long it has already been sitting on your shelf. 'I didn't know it was cancelled' is not a defence when the record is public and you simply didn't check.

If you're a retailer, dropshipper or cosmetics shop owner, check this list before you commit to new stock, not after a customer messages asking why the product they bought from you is on it.

Due diligence isn't NPRA's job alone. If it's on your shelf, checking it is on you too.

posts.hook: People keep treating "formaldehyde-free keratin treatment" as a slogan to be debunked, not a claim to be tested. The reflex is: glyoxylic acid still smells like the old Brazilian Blowout, so it must still release formaldehyde. That reflex skips the actual chemistry.

bm.linkedin:
Ramai anggap "formaldehyde-free keratin treatment" ni cuma slogan pemasaran untuk dipatahkan, bukan dakwaan untuk diuji. Refleks biasa: glyoxylic acid masih berbau macam Brazilian Blowout lama, jadi mesti masih bebaskan formaldehyde. Refleks tu langkau kimia sebenar.

Glyoxylic acid tak ikut laluan tindak balas yang sama macam sistem methylene glycol/formaldehyde. Kajian dedahan sebenar terbaru dalam Toxicology and Applied Pharmacology sokong ni dengan data dermal exposure sebenar, bukan andaian.

Dedahan oxalic acid pengguna daripada produk ni 20 hingga 41 kali lebih rendah berbanding pengambilan diet dan endogenous oxalate harian biasa (22 hingga 45 mg/hari). Untuk penggaya rambut yang buat aplikasi berulang, dedahan lebih 860 kali lebih rendah. Pelepasan formaldehyde kekal bawah had regulatory sepanjang tempoh rawatan.

Itulah standard yang patut dipakai untuk dakwaan ni: exposure data terukur berbanding baseline sebenar, bukan uji bau berdasarkan skandal lama. Kalau nak cabar dakwaan "formaldehyde-free", bawa exposure data, bukan ingatan tahun 2010.

Sources: Toxicology and Applied Pharmacology, Epub 9 July 2026 [SAHKAN: authors, volume/issue, DOI]

#CosmeticScience #RegulatoryAffairs #KeratinTreatment #ExposureAssessment #HairCareChemistry

en.linkedin:
People keep treating "formaldehyde-free keratin treatment" as a slogan to be debunked, not a claim to be tested. The reflex is: glyoxylic acid still smells like the old Brazilian Blowout, so it must still release formaldehyde. That reflex skips the actual chemistry.

Glyoxylic acid does not follow the same reaction pathway as methylene glycol/formaldehyde systems. A new measured-exposure study in Toxicology and Applied Pharmacology backs that up with real dermal exposure data, not assumptions.

Consumer oxalic acid exposure from these products came in 20 to 41 times lower than typical daily dietary and endogenous oxalate intake (22 to 45 mg/day). For hairstylists doing repeated applications, exposure was over 860 times lower. Formaldehyde release stayed under regulatory limits for the full treatment duration.

That is the standard this claim should be held to: measured exposure against a real baseline, not a smell test against an old scandal. If you want to challenge a "formaldehyde-free" claim, bring exposure data, not a memory of 2010.

Sources: Toxicology and Applied Pharmacology, Epub 9 July 2026

#CosmeticScience #RegulatoryAffairs #KeratinTreatment #ExposureAssessment #HairCareChemistry

posts.hook: Sijil pembekal anda belum luput. Tapi itu bukan jaminan sijil itu masih sah.

bm.instagram:
Ramai founder anggap kerja siasat pembekal habis sebaik sijil halal disemak semasa onboarding. Bukan begitu caranya.

JAKIM boleh menarik balik pengiktirafan sesebuah badan pensijilan halal luar negara pada bila-bila masa. Bila itu berlaku, sijil yang badan tersebut keluarkan tidak lagi boleh menyokong status halal produk siap anda, walaupun sijil di tangan anda masih belum luput tarikhnya.

Ini isu yang jarang dibincangkan sebab ia tidak viral. Tapi untuk pengimport bahan mentah, kesannya paling mahal: seluruh batch boleh kehilangan asas halal tanpa anda sedar, sebab yang anda semak ialah sijil, bukan status pengiktirafan badan yang keluarkan sijil itu.

Yang perlu ada dalam sistem jaminan halal anda: satu senarai semak yang menyemak status pengiktirafan setiap badan pensijilan pembekal anda, sekurang-kurangnya setiap suku tahun. Bukan sekali sahaja semasa daftar pembekal baharu.

Sumber rasmi untuk semakan itu ialah senarai Foreign Halal Certification Body di portal Halal Malaysia (halal.gov.my). Senarai itu yang mengikat status halal anda, bukan sijil fizikal yang tersimpan dalam fail.
bm.facebook:
Sijil halal pembekal masih belum luput tarikh tak bermakna ia masih sah digunakan.

JAKIM boleh menarik pengiktirafan sesebuah badan pensijilan halal luar negara bila-bila masa. Bila itu berlaku, produk siap anda hilang asas halal walaupun sijil di tangan masih valid.

Masukkan dalam sistem jaminan halal anda: semakan status pengiktirafan badan pensijilan setiap pembekal, sekurang-kurangnya setiap suku tahun, rujuk senarai Foreign Halal Certification Body di halal.gov.my. Senarai itu yang mengikat, bukan sijil dalam fail.
bm.threads: Sijil pembekal belum luput bukan bermakna ia masih sah. JAKIM boleh tarik pengiktirafan badan pensijilan luar negara bila-bila masa, dan bila itu berlaku produk siap anda hilang asas halal serta merta. Semak status badan pensijilan pembekal anda di senarai Foreign Halal Certification Body, halal.gov.my, setiap suku tahun. Bukan sekali masa onboarding.

en.instagram:
Most founders think supplier due diligence ends once the halal certificate is checked during onboarding. That is not how it works.

JAKIM can withdraw recognition from a foreign halal certification body at any time. When that happens, certificates issued by that body can no longer support your finished product's halal status, even if the certificate you are holding has not expired.

This never trends online, but for importers of raw materials it is the most expensive thing to miss: an entire batch can lose its halal basis without you knowing, because what you checked was the certificate, not the recognition status of the body that issued it.

What needs to be in your halal assurance system: a checklist that verifies the recognition status of every supplier's certification body, at minimum every quarter, not just once at supplier registration.

The official reference for that check is the Foreign Halal Certification Body section on the Halal Malaysia portal (halal.gov.my). That list governs your halal status, not the paper sitting in your file.
en.facebook:
An unexpired certificate from your supplier does not mean it is still valid.

JAKIM can withdraw recognition from a foreign halal certification body at any time. When that happens, your finished product loses its halal basis even if the physical certificate is not expired.

Build this into your halal assurance system: check the recognition status of each supplier's certification body at least every quarter, against the Foreign Halal Certification Body list on halal.gov.my. That list is what binds you, not the certificate in your file.
en.threads: An unexpired supplier certificate does not mean it is still valid. JAKIM can withdraw recognition from a foreign halal certification body anytime, and your finished product loses its halal basis the moment that happens. Check your suppliers' certification bodies against the Foreign Halal Certification Body list on halal.gov.my every quarter, not just once at onboarding.

posts.hook: Liquid lipo is not a facial. It is deoxycholic acid, phosphatidylcholine and L-carnitine injected into the body, and a case report in Annals of African Medicine, published online 24 September 2026, shows exactly why that matters.

bm.linkedin:
Liquid lipo bukan facial. Ia adalah deoxycholic acid, phosphatidylcholine dan L-carnitine yang disuntik ke dalam badan, dan satu case report dalam Annals of African Medicine, published online 24 September 2026, tunjukkan kenapa ini penting.

Seorang wanita 31 tahun tanpa sejarah penyakit hati mengalami severe hepatocellular drug-induced liver injury selepas suntikan tersebut: ALT 2227 U/L, bilirubin 6.2 mg/dL. Doktor bagi IV N-acetylcysteine, antidote standard. Selepas itu dia pula alami anaphylactic reaction terhadap antidote tersebut.

Itu dua systemic pharmacological event daripada satu prosedur yang dipasarkan sebagai cosmetic, bukan satu.

Di Malaysia, sebarang injectable yang bertindak dalam badan adalah drug atau medical device, bukan notified cosmetic product. Premis yang menjalankannya jatuh bawah Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998, bukan lesen salun kecantikan, dan injector perlu dilatih untuk kenal dan urus anaphylaxis serta drug-induced liver injury, bukan sekadar teknik suntikan.

Kalau klinik tawarkan liquid lipo bawah notifikasi cosmetic, file itu memang tak pernah dinilai untuk risiko ini. Keputusan classification itulah yang tentukan siapa yang layak dari segi undang-undang untuk uruskan komplikasi bila ia berlaku.

Sources: Case report, Annals of African Medicine, published online 24 Sept 2026 [SAHKAN: authors and DOI, not retrievable without direct journal database access]; Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998.

#RegulatoryAffairs #Cosmetovigilance #NPRA #PatientSafety #AestheticMedicine

en.linkedin:
Liquid lipo is not a facial. It is deoxycholic acid, phosphatidylcholine and L-carnitine injected into the body, and a case report in Annals of African Medicine, published online 24 September 2026, shows exactly why that matters.

A 31-year-old woman with no prior liver disease developed severe hepatocellular drug-induced liver injury after the injection: ALT 2227 U/L, bilirubin 6.2 mg/dL. Doctors gave IV N-acetylcysteine, the standard antidote. She then had an anaphylactic reaction to the antidote itself.

That is two systemic pharmacological events from one procedure marketed as cosmetic, not one.

In Malaysia, an injectable that acts inside the body is a drug or medical device, not a notified cosmetic product. The premise administering it falls under the Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998, not a beauty-salon licence, and the injector needs training to recognise and manage anaphylaxis and drug-induced liver injury, not just injection technique.

If a clinic offers liquid lipo under a cosmetic notification, that file was never assessed for this. The classification decision is what determines who is legally allowed to manage the complication when it happens.

Sources: Case report, Annals of African Medicine, published online 24 Sept 2026; Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998.

#RegulatoryAffairs #Cosmetovigilance #NPRA #PatientSafety #AestheticMedicine
